entries.name: Sam Darnold
entries.summary: Darnold (glute) is ahead of schedule in his recovery and has a chance to practice ahead of Seattle's Week 3 road game against the Commanders, head coach Mike Macdonald said after Sunday's 31-7 victory over the Cardinals, Curtis Crabtree of Fox 13 Seattle reports.

entries.name: Zach Charbonnet
entries.summary: Coach Mike Macdonald said Friday that the Seahawks are drawing closer to setting a date for Charbonnet (knee) to resume practicing, Gregg Bell of The Tacoma News Tribune reports.

entries.name: Zay Flowers
entries.summary: inactive

entries.name: Caleb Williams
entries.summary: Bears head coach Ben Johnson said Monday that Williams' right hamstring injury is likely "gonna be a week-to-week deal," Kevin Fishbain of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Demarcus Robinson
entries.summary: Robinson (ankle) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Dolphins, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Jayden Daniels
entries.summary: Daniels was carted off the field at the conclusion of the first half of Sundays' game against Dallas due to a left arm injury, Tashan Reed of The Washington Post reports.

entries.name: Jordan Whittington
entries.summary: Whittington (quadriceps) is doubtful to play in Monday's game against the Giants, Benjamin Royer of The Orange County Register reports.

entries.name: Alec Pierce
entries.summary: Pierce is set for further tests on his left heel Monday, but X-rays returned negative after he exited Sunday's game against the Chiefs in the first half, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Bo Melton
entries.summary: Melton is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Jets due to a stinger.

entries.name: Caleb Douglas
entries.summary: Douglas (ankle) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the 49ers.

entries.name: Charlie Kolar
entries.summary: Kolar (forearm) was spotted with his left arm in a sling following Sunday's 26-14 loss to the Raiders, Kris Rhim of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Dallas Goedert
entries.summary: Goedert (knee) is slated to undergo an MRI on Monday after exiting Sunday's 24-20 win over the Titans, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Dareke Young
entries.summary: Young (hamstring) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Chargers.

entries.name: David Njoku
entries.summary: Njoku (knee) won't return to Sunday's game against the Raiders.

entries.name: DJ Moore
entries.summary: The Bills are treating Moore as day-to-day after he was diagnosed with an AC joint sprain in his shoulder after exiting Thursday's 41-31 win over the Lions, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Eli Raridon
entries.summary: Raridon (thigh) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Steelers.

entries.name: J.K. Dobbins
entries.summary: The Broncos believe that Dobbins' injured hamstring is "good" heading into next Sunday's game against the Rams, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

entries.name: Jadarian Price
entries.summary: Coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Price suffered a shoulder injury during Sunday's win at Arizona, but "it's intact and nothing serious, it seems like," Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Jayden Reed
entries.summary: Coach Matt LaFleur said Reed has movement in all of his extremities after he suffered a neck injury during Sunday's 20-17 overtime win at the Jets, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Jaylen Wright
entries.summary: Wright (neck) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the 49ers.

entries.name: Jonathon Brooks
entries.summary: Head coach Dave Canales said Monday that Brooks is having tests done on the groin injury that he sustained during Sunday's 34-3 win in Atlanta, and an update on the running back's health will arrive Wednesday, Sheena Quick of Fox Sports Radio 1340 reports.

entries.name: Mason Taylor
entries.summary: Taylor (thumb) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Packers, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Mike Evans
entries.summary: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said after Sunday's 35-13 win over the Dolphins that Evans (hip) is fine, Vic Tafur of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Puka Nacua
entries.summary: Nacua (hip), who is officially listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Giants, "is trending the wrong way" in advance of the Week 2 contest, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Rico Dowdle
entries.summary: Dowdle has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Patriots, Brooke Pryor of ESPN.com reports. He finished with seven carries for 22 yards and two catches for 22 yards on two targets.

entries.name: Saquon Barkley
entries.summary: The Eagles announced that Barkley (neck/shoulder) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Titans due to a stinger.

entries.name: A.J. Brown
entries.summary: Brown, who was officially placed on injured reserve Saturday, is expected to miss about six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Caleb Lohner
entries.summary: Lohner (lower body) was placed on injured reserve by the Broncos on Sunday with a designation to return, Aric DiLalla of the team's official website reports.

entries.name: David Sills
entries.summary: Sills (undisclosed) was placed on injured reserve by the Buccaneers on Sunday with a designation to return, Scott Smith of the team's official website reports.

entries.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
entries.summary: The 49ers placed Stribling (ankle) on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: Dillon Gabriel
entries.summary: ir

entries.name: Dylan Sampson

entries.name: Eli Stowers
entries.summary: The Eagles placed Stowers (quadriceps/hamstring) on injured reserve Saturday.

entries.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
entries.summary: Coach Jesse Minter said Lane underwent wrist surgery Wednesday, and the Ravens placed the rookie wide receiver on injured reserve, Brian Wacker of The Baltimore Sun reports.

entries.name: Jake Tonges
entries.summary: Tonges (knee) requires surgery for an MCL tear and is done for the season, Cam Inman reports.

entries.name: Jimmy Holiday
entries.summary: Holiday (undisclosed) was placed on injured reserve by the Chiefs on Sunday.

entries.name: Jordan Mason
entries.summary: ir
